description:
Features Include:


Would I Always Be... Tomorrows Bride?
Cupid On Your Mind
A Heart Filled With Fear!
Afraid To Marry!
A Love To Fight For!

Arms dealer Griff makes war his job but none of his business! That is, until he's an innocent bystander during an assassination attempt and shot down with his own product. Will Griff develop a conscience? You'll be surprised at the answer.

Hard-hitting jungle combat in the conclusion of this Heavy Hitter, complete with a bound-in trading card. Griffin and his two men are being tracked by the mercenaries who shot them down in deep jungle. But who'll get Griffin first, the mercs or the treacherous jungle itself?
"Tough Guy" is the title of the 2 page text story within...
"Saturday Night Date" is the title of the 2 page text story within...
